q:
What is the output of the following algorithm?
a = 48, b = 18
while b != 0
  t = b
  b = a mod b
  a = t
print a
exp: This is Euclid's algorithm: gcd(48, 18) = gcd(18, 12) = gcd(12, 6) = gcd(6, 0) = 6.
